name: Go.gov.sg (official government link shortener)

scam_info.sample: The official Singapore government link shortener
scam_info.notes: The sample is the og:description; the page is a JS SPA with no server text. Official short-link domain (listed on gov.sg Trusted Sites with for.sg and for.edu.sg). Agencies use it for report/resource links (e.g. go.gov.sg/scamreport, go.gov.sg/report-sms, go.gov.sg/scamshield-bot, go.gov.sg/csa-cyber-aid, go.gov.sg/mlaw-rom-list-licensed-moneylenders). No public directory: the GoGovSG directory requires a gov-officer login (per survey). robots.txt only addresses NLB_archive_bot.

scam_info.sample: Trusted short links from healthcare institutions
scam_info.notes: Sister short-link domain for healthcare institutions (www.for.sg redirects to https://for.sg/). for.edu.sg is the education variant (listed on Trusted Sites, not fetched).

notes: Treat go.gov.sg/for.sg/for.edu.sg links as official (allowlist), but the destination still needs checking. No scam-info pages.
